description: FastAPI application with two endpoints: one for uploading raw bytes files and another for uploading files as UploadFile objects.

methods.name: create_file(file: bytes = File(description="A file read as bytes"))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /files/ endpoint; reads the uploaded file as bytes and returns its size.

methods.name: create_upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(description="A file read as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /uploadfile/ endpoint; processes uploaded file as UploadFile object and returns filename.

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_file(file: bytes = File(description="A file read as bytes")):$/
ctags.signature: (file: bytes = File(description="A file read as bytes"))

ctags.name: create_upload_file
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(description="A file read as UploadFile"), )
